note: Corps of Engineers campground in hardwoods on the north side of 150-acre Eau Galle Lake near Spring Valley, with trails to a swimming beach. The 10-site equestrian Prairie Loop is a separate area about 1.3 km north of the main loop. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov facility record, rates, catalog and calendar read; USACE MVP page refuses (Akamai). $24 (site 25, non-electric RV) / $28 electric 2026 and 2027 confirmed; 50A; 46 sites, 35 RV sites in the main loop (25-60 ft but 35 at 20 ft); showers, flush toilets, dump; season May 1-Nov 15 from the calendar; max stay 14. Pin is the entrance road ~530 m north of the loop; re-pin proposed. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PIN: 44.8726,-92.2433 -> 44.8678,-92.2439 (about 530 m; centroid of the catalog's main-loop site coordinates 01-38). The stored point is recreation.gov's facility point at the north end of the campground road.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The lake lies about 200 m+ south of the southernmost sites (17-21) through continuous forest on Esri imagery; no view either.
HORSES: the equestrian Prairie Loop (39E-48E) is a separate loop ~1.3 km north of the main loop with its own road; not mixed. Fine.
FIT: 34 of 35 main-loop RV sites list 25 ft+; site 35 is 20 ft. A few sites (08, 20, 32, 38) list Trailer/Fifth Wheel but not RV - a catalog quirk, plenty of RV sites remain.
SEASON: added 05-01..11-15 from the calendar (2026 opened Apr 30); the Corps notice says opening/closing dates vary with weather.
PHONE 715-778-5562 confirmed (recreation.gov). WEBSITE: rec.gov link live; the MVP Eau Galle page answers 403 (Akamai) to plain HTTP; keep.
